summary.en: Let Desktop prepare and start an iOS Simulator, prepare the iOS device-control agent, and explain actionable physical-iPhone readiness failures.
summary.zh: 让 Desktop 准备并启动 iOS 模拟器、准备 iOS 设备控制代理，并为 iPhone 真机就绪失败提供可操作说明。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: Simulator preparation and physical-iPhone agent readiness run in the Desktop Host and Web client; they do not change Mobile source, build inputs, or artifacts.
The local iOS environment and device-control paths do not change Platform services, deployment inputs, or wire formats.
